description: This is a vintage-style vanity stool with a plush, tufted purple seat and backrest. The frame and legs are made of ornate, scrolled metal, likely brass or a similar polished metal, adding an element of elegance and a touch of old-world charm. The circular seat is generously padded, and the oval backrest features a similar tufted design within an decorative metal frame. The base has four splayed legs that curve outwards, each ending in a small, cylindrical foot. This chair appears to be designed for a dressing table or vanity area, offering both comfort and a decorative statement.
